suggestions.description: The first three category rows omit the Rename affordance instead of explicitly representing the unavailable action as disabled.
suggestions.evidence: At approximately logical y=230-410, the candidate shows category names and counts only, with each count at the far-right content edge. The matching reference places a Rename button at the right of each of these three rows and its count immediately before the button. The candidate sidecar records all category detail rows as enabled=false, but no disabled rename button or equivalent unavailable action is visible. Uncategorized correctly has no Rename affordance.
suggestions.recommendation: Preserve a trailing Rename affordance for each of the first three category rows and render it explicitly disabled while renaming is unimplemented. Keep the count before that disabled affordance, retain the existing row geometry, and keep Uncategorized immutable. Do not simulate a successful rename.

limitations: This independent review covers only the four case pairs in reference-27.input.json. It does not declare the entire round clean.

Only existing JSON and original PNG files were read, and Get-FileHash was used for PNG identity. No application, build, tests, validation suite, runtime probe, Git operation, or product modification was performed.

Candidate captures are 930x1240 at logical scale 1. Reference originals are 1860x2480 at physical scale 2; tools.view_image displayed the references resized to 1368x1824. Geometry was compared at equivalent logical dimensions without modifying the original evidence bytes.
Coordinate descriptions are approximate visual estimates. This review did not use programmatic pixel measurement or derive contrast ratios.

Screenshots and supplied sidecars establish visible state and declared capabilities, but do not prove click outcomes, language switching, rename behavior, download completion, processed-image output, or physical e-ink behavior.
The full download destination is present in the supplied JSON but truncated in the PNG. No path-reveal interaction or separate long-path stress case was examined.
The aggregate reference tree SHA-256 was supplied by the task and was not recomputed in this four-case review; every reviewed reference PNG was independently hashed and matched its sidecar.
